pages.text: Can a deceased enchanter still perform enchantments? As long as you wear the Nameless Set and let them meet an untimely end, you can raise a bound enchanter anew. They can continue to wield their enchanted books even in their undead form.
Of course, you can also summon a Bound Enchanter directly through a ritual.
Bound Enchanters retain their former craft, still granting temporary enchantments to nearby allies.
